title: SS27 Kids' Trending Trims Report
summary: Sailor collars and nautical tape, handcrafted embroidery, character appliqués, shells and sparkling details lead SS27 kidswear trims, under strict safety rules.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Nautical details:** sailor collars and navy at Playtime Paris<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Character elements and layered accessories**<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Handcrafted embroidery:** Fatamadrina's "Wildflowers Bloom" uses delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Shells, pebbles, seaweed and embroideries:** on Selini Action's handmade costumes<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Sparkle:** Pitti Bimbo's Pirouette runway promised "bold looks, sparkling details, and positive vibes"<sup>[4]</sup>.

sections.heading: Trims table
sections.body:
| Trim | Application | Status | Safety note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sailor collar and tape | Tops, dresses | Rising | None specific |
| Embroidery | Dresses, shirts | Rising | Soft backing on skin side |
| Character appliqué | Tees, sets | Core | Securely stitched, no loose edges |
| Shell and bead decoration | Swim, costumes | Emerging | Pull-test; avoid for under-3s |
| Sequins and sparkle | Party | Seasonal | Line the inside; check edges |

design_implications:
- Prefer printed or embroidered motifs to attached parts for baby and toddler.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Embroidery and appliqué add value to core tees and dresses without new blocks.
